slides.on_image_text: POV: I sent you a reel 0.2 seconds ago
slides.beat: The send. Hope is still alive.
slides.emotion_aachu: bright, expectant, thumb just lifted off send
slides.emotion_zuv: relaxed, already absorbed in his own phone

slides.on_image_text: and you're laughing at YOUR phone
slides.beat: He is visibly delighted — at the wrong content.
slides.emotion_aachu: first side-eye, head turned, smile gone flat
slides.emotion_zuv: laughing warmly at his own screen, utterly oblivious

slides.on_image_text: you watched it. and said NOTHING.
slides.beat: Peak. The receipt exists; the reaction does not.
slides.emotion_aachu: full unblinking playful side-eye filling the frame; one eyebrow up; betrayal as comedy
slides.emotion_zuv: soft-focus oblivious profile at frame edge

slides.on_image_text: ...you were sending me the SAME reel.
slides.beat: Pivot punchline. His reaction finally arrives — he was sending her the exact same reel. Parallel discovery, not neglect.
slides.emotion_aachu: glare collapsing into incredulous laughter, phone still raised toward him
slides.emotion_zuv: turned fully to her, holding his phone out toward her face-to-face with hers, delighted, mid-laugh
slides.crime: symmetric — the whole fight was mutual
